headline: Why did he ghost me?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NEVER SUPPLY HIS REASON — not scared, not overwhelmed, not 'he couldn't cope', not 'he left because', not 'the reason he'. The reason lives in a man who did not give it, and inventing one hands her something false to act on. 🔴 Never a verdict on his person, 🔴 never invent a third person, and 🔴 note that 'it was never about you' and 'he was protecting you' are banned too — they are motive claims wearing reassurance. 🔴 No tactic in either direction: no reaching out, no one last message, no blocking, no no-contact. 🔴 No promise of closure.

Finding: she has been handed a silence and asked to author its meaning. The read refuses to author it for her and names the work she has been doing instead.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the flowers under his table are still growing.
You asked why he ghosted you. Your hand went to the man who leaves a mark when he acts.
So this left no mark, dear. That's the strange part of it.
And every act on that table leaves a mark, dear. This one left none.
But a person just going gives you nothing to read, dear.
That's why you write the reason yourself, dear. Night after night.
Let me look closer at what has been filling that silence…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — there's no ladder and no one else in the picture.
You asked why he ghosted you. Your hand went to the card that leaves a thing hanging.
So nothing was finished, dear. It was just left.
And he hangs there, dear, with nobody coming to say why.
But an ending has words in it, dear. This one had none.
That's why the silence reads like a verdict, dear. It isn't one.
Let me look closer at what has been standing in for those words…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his left hand is empty and open.
You asked why he ghosted you. Your hand went to the one who owes no account.
So you were owed an account, dear. You didn't get one.
And he walks off with an open hand, dear, and nothing in it.
But I won't invent a reason to fill that, dear. Nobody honestly can.
That's why the gap stays, dear. It was never yours to explain.
Let me look closer at what has been sitting in that gap…
